Hi Neha,

I lead the AI & Society Lab at Universidad de los Andes. We're running a student-driven research track this summer investigating bias in multilingual models for Spanish and indigenous languages. Our budget is tight and we rely on platform credits from vendors for compute.

Could Redwood provide promotional credits or extend a trial for non-profit/academic research? Attached: short research_proposal.pdf and IRB_approval_letter.pdf.

Key ask:
- Credits to cover inference for ~6 months (~3k-6k USD estimated)
- Ability to access embeddings + generation endpoints
- Confirmation of academic/non-profit pricing or waivers

We're happy to provide a short writeup of work and attribution guidance if that helps.

Thanks — looking forward to hearing next steps.

Best,
Daniel Ruiz
